notes.title: Patch 1.0.10 – Improvements & Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello detectives!

A new patch is here with several improvements and fixes to enhance your experience in [i]The Stepfather Remake[/i]. Here’s what’s new:

🔹 [b]Inventory & UI Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Some inventory icons have been updated to display text in English.
[*] Fixed missing descriptions for some items when using a gamepad.
[*] Added a message to the language selection screen to clarify how to switch languages.
[/list]
🔹 [b]Performance & Visual Enhancements[/b]

[list]
[*] Optimized VFX particle systems in some scenes to improve performance.
[/list]
🔹 [b]Achievement Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some collected items were not counted correctly for the Diogenes Syndrome achievement. If you’ve already acquired items in a saved game, loading your save will now update the achievement count automatically.
[/list]

As always, thank you for your feedback and support! If you find any other issues, let us know in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3525020/discussions/1/]Steam forums[/url]. Happy investigating!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9.2 - Bug Fixes & Minor Improvements
notes.notes:
Hello, detectives! We've just released a new patch to fix some bugs and improve the overall experience.

[list]
[*] Main Fix: The Hint Journal can now be opened correctly from the inventory when playing with a gamepad. No more excuses for getting stuck!
[/list]
Other Minor Fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed some small bugs to improve game stability.
[*] Minor UI adjustments for a smoother experience.
[/list]
Thanks to everyone for your feedback and bug reports! We’re always listening and working to improve The Stepfather Remake. See you on the case! 

Found any other issues? Let us know in the Steam forums! 👇
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3525020/discussions/1/]Tech Support Forum[/url]

notes.title: The Stepfather Remake is now available!
notes.notes:
[i]The Stepfather Remake[/i] is real. The city is under Va Cappone’s grip, the Milk Law has turned dairy into a forbidden commodity, and Aurelliot, a down-on-his-luck detective, has stumbled into the biggest mess of his career.

He has no idea how it came to this. What started as a simple case has spiraled into blackmail, secrets, and missing cows. And somehow… it all makes sense.

We had a blast telling this story, and we hope you enjoy it as much as we did. Welcome to a city where justice is shady, mobsters are clueless, and milk is the most valuable commodity!

We’d love to hear what you think, so drop by the community and share your experience.

Mideas Game Studio

[b]Play now on Steam![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3525020/The_Stepfather_Remake/
